verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੯ : ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਝੂਠੇ ਵੈਦ
verses.translit_en: pauRee 9 : gur poore binaa(n) jhooThe vaidh

en.bdb: Exceptthe perfect Guru all physicians are fake

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵੈਦੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਰੋਗੀ ਵੈਦੁ ਨ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: satigur vaidh na sevio rogee vaidh na rog miTaavai|

en.bdb: The true physician in the form of true Guru (God) has never been served; then how could a physician who himself is diseased remove the malady of others?

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਧ੍ਰੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: kaam krodh vich lobh moh dhubidhaa kar kar dhroh vadhaavai|

en.bdb: These worldly physicians who themselves are engrossed in the lust, anger, greed, infatuation, deceive people and enhance their diseases.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਧਿ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: aadh biaadh upaadh vich mar mar ja(n)mai dhukh vihaavai|

en.bdb: This way man involved in these ailments goes on transmigrating and remains full of suffering.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਭਵਜਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: aavai jai bhavaieeaai bhavajal a(n)dhar paar na paavai|

en.bdb: He goes stray by coming and going and becomes unable to go across the world-ocean.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਤਾਮਸੁ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: aasaa manasaa mohanee taamas tisanaa saa(n)t na aavai|

en.bdb: Hopes and desires always attract his mind and being guided by evil propensities he never attains peace.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਲਦੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤੇਲੁ ਪਾਇ ਕਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਅਗਿ ਬੁਝਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: baladhee a(n)dhar tel pai kiau man moorakh ag bujhaavai|

en.bdb: How could a manmukh extinguish fire by putting oil on it?
Who except the perfect Guru can liberate man from these bondage's?
